About — Al-Haq Initiative | Founder & Mission About the Al-Haq Initiative The Al-Haq Initiative is dedicated to seeking truth in history and protecting health in the present. Our work fuses rigorous primary-source research with digital tools that empower the community. Our Mission Develop innovative, spiritually enriching digital solutions and historical research that help the community deepen knowledge, strengthen practice, and build resilience. Our Vision To be a trusted source of verified historical knowledge and protection tools, making authentic research and community-centered technology

urce of verified historical knowledge and protection tools, making authentic research and community-centered technology accessible to all. Our Values check_circle Truth in Sources: Rigorous verification through primary documents, never political distortion. check_circle Community Empowerment: Tools and resources that strengthen identity, scholarship, and wellbeing. check_circle Islamic Ethics: All content and technology reflects Islamic values and protects against harm. check_circle Free & Accessible: All research and core resources available free, no paywalls. About the Founder Afrasyaab Mera

About the Founder Afrasyaab Meranai — known casually as Habibur Rahman — is the founder, developer, and writer of the Al-Haq Initiative. Al-Fatiha Tafsir "The Opening" - This surah is the foundation of the Quran and teaches us the proper way to address Allah in prayer. Al-Ikhlas Tafsir "The Sincerity" - This surah is equivalent to one-third of the Quran and emphasizes the pure monotheism of Islam. Tafsir Al-Tabari One of the earliest and most comprehensive tafir works, covering historical context and linguistic analysis. Tafsir Al-Qurtubi A detailed tafir that focuses on legal rulings and practical applications of Quranic verses. Help & FAQ — Al-Haq Initiative Help & FAQ Find answers to common questions and get help with our services. Frequently Asked Questions About Al-Haq Initiative What is Al-Haq Initiative? Al-Haq Initiative (مبادرة الحق) is a personal initiative for "Seeking the Truth" — truth in history and protection in the present. It publishes free academic research, booklets, and digital tools. Learn more on the About page. Who runs Al-Haq Initiative? Afrasyaab Meranai — known casually as Habibur Rahman — is the sole founder, developer, and writer. He owns and operates both ADS Solutions (his UK sole-trader b

bibur Rahman — is the sole founder, developer, and writer. He owns and operates both ADS Solutions (his UK sole-trader business) and the Al-Haq Initiative brand. Is Al-Haq Initiative a charity, non-profit, or organization? No. Al-Haq Initiative is not a charity, non-profit, NGO, or registered organization. It is a personal effort hosted under ADS Solutions (UK sole trader). The founder may later convert it into a registered organization, but that has not happened yet. What is ADS Solutions? ADS Solutions is the founder's UK sole-trader business. It builds and delivers all software, products, a

ADS Solutions? ADS Solutions is the founder's UK sole-trader business. It builds and delivers all software, products, and professional services associated with Al-Haq Initiative (web development, security, infrastructure, custom Islamic apps, consulting). See Products & Services . Who writes the academic and literary work? All academic and literary work — including Faith Sellers (بائعي القدر) , Lessons from Islamic Civilization , and The Caretaker's Guide — is authored personally by the founder. ess the Quran and Hadith sections? Go to the Library page and select the Quran or Hadith section to explore translations, tafsir, and authentic collections. Quran Hub How do I use Quran Hub? Open Quran Hub , choose a surah, then use the reading controls to jump to an ayah, change font size, resume your last session, browse translations, and listen to recitation. Can I use Quran Hub on Windows, phone, and browsers? Yes. Quran Hub works across desktop browsers, Windows laptops, Android phones, iPhone, iPad, and tablets. Chrome and Edge usually offer the best install-as-app experience on desktop

Android phones, iPhone, iPad, and tablets. Chrome and Edge usually offer the best install-as-app experience on desktop and Android. On iPhone and iPad, use Safari and choose Add to Home Screen from the Share menu for an app-like experience. Can I install Quran Hub like an app? If your browser supports it, Quran Hub can be installed as a web app. On Windows, Edge and Chrome usually provide the cleanest app window and taskbar shortcut. ari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen . Does Quran Hub work offline?
